findings.description: Malformed integer path parameters reach Prisma and return internal server errors instead of a 4xx validation response; some include internal source/query details.

Leaderboard limit accepts negative/noninteger/nonnumeric values without schema validation. Negative values return managers from the bottom of the ordering; fractional values are truncated; zero/nonnumeric values silently become 50.
Historical reconstruction leaves unknown played/points/club identity as numeric zero. The legacy API serializes these zeroes without a missing-data flag; winner identity/counts can still be valid.
Team, Match, MatchDetail and SeasonStanding are empty; real-data match statistics, goals, W/D/L, lineups, ratings and reconstructed league-table arithmetic cannot be verified from this snapshot.

scope: All 12 registerReadRoutes GET families plus health and two scrape reads. Every stored country, season, manager profile and nationality leaderboard checked. No CHPP or writes. Invalid-input probes reported separately from successful-data equality assertions.
